| STOP gate | A fixed point in a dispatch where work halts for verification. | B1; also B8, B12 |
| Storable bipropellants | Fuel-plus-oxidiser pairs that stay liquid at room temperature; DEC-13-5's 300–350 s class (description from memory, verify). | B7 |
| Straight-line amortization | Amortization that gives every period an equal share. | A9 |
| Strain (ε) | Stretch divided by the starting length, a dimensionless fraction often written as a percentage. | A6 |
| Strands | The parallel fibre lines of a Hoytether. | A7 |
| Strength retention | The fraction of datasheet fibre strength kept after the derate, 1 − d (0.70 in the Conservative case). | A1; also A6, A9, A11 |
| Stress | Force per unit area carried by a material. | A1; also A6 |
| STRICT (validation class) | Aster's gated validation class: error measured on well-behaved published curve segments, which must pass a fixed bar (5% for launch-vehicle payload points). | B7; also B8 |
| Strict scenario pass rate | The share of scenarios in which every graded run was fully faithful. | B11 |
| String (JSON) | Text in double quotes. | A1; also A11 |
| Structurally blind | L2 bodies (482 Jupiter-crossers and 206 comets) whose error drivers lie beyond what CAD reports, so measurement cannot promote them. | B4 |
| Structure (dry or inert mass) | The tanks, engines, legs, heat shield and avionics a rocket carries that are not propellant or payload. | A4 |
| Structure fraction (ε) | Dry structure mass divided by gross lift-off mass, the convention Skyhook's code uses. | A4 |
| Structured clone | The deep copy the browser makes of data sent in a message. | B9 |
| Stumpff functions | The functions c₂(ψ) and c₃(ψ) of universal-variable orbit formulas; Aster's stumpff.ts switches to their series form when \\\|ψ\\\| &lt; 1e-6. | B8 |

| Suborbital (flight, trajectory) | Not reaching orbital speed: a path that comes back down before completing an orbit, which speed decides, not height. | A3; also A4, A10 |

| Substrate / Lens | In the strategy documents, the shared core that a family of products is built on, and one such product that answers one operational question. | B12 |

| Supportable (reboost bound) | A grid cell whose recovery time is no longer than the inter-catch interval. | A5 |
| Surcharge | Extra rate charged for an unproven system with no actuarial record; it scales with insured value per kg (+5-10 points early per MP-001). | A10 |
| Swept annulus (swept volume) | The flat ring of altitudes, in the orbit plane, that a rotating tether's tips pass through: 290-930 km for Rev A. | A10 |

| T_min(M) | The shortest normalised flight time for which an M-lap solution exists, the bottom of the U-shaped T(x) curve. | B5 |
| Tag | A human-readable name pinned to one git commit, such as slice16-prereg-v1. | B11; also B12 |
| TAI (International Atomic Time) | International Atomic Time, a uniform count of SI seconds from atomic clocks that never jumps. | B1; also B2 |
| Take-or-pay | An offtake contract in which the buyer pays even if it does not use the service. | A10 |
| TAM (total addressable market) | Everyone who could ever want the service. | A10 |
| Tamper seal | A check that proves nobody altered data on purpose; Skyhook's MD5 provenance hash explicitly is not one. | A11 |
| Tangent | The direction along a circle at a given point; a released payload leaves along it. | A2 |
| TanStack Virtual | A third-party list-virtualisation library that Aster declares as a dependency but does not import. | B9 |
| Taper | The way a uniform-stress tether's cross-section shrinks from hub to tip. | A6 |

| Virtual node (VNode) | A cheap JavaScript object describing an interface element, compared before the real DOM is changed. | B9 |
| Virtualisation (windowing) | Creating DOM nodes only for the list rows near the visible area instead of for every row. | B9 |
| Vis-viva equation | v² = mu(2/r - 1/a), which gives the speed at any radius on any orbit. | A3; also B3, B5 |
| Visualization-tier / not-kepler-safe / planning-tier | The INV-014b labels: passed all three gates; failed at least one; and a named policy label with no members. | B4 |
| Vite | The build tool Aster uses to serve source in development and to bundle the site into docs/ for release. | B9 |
| VM-001 | The project's first verification memo (docs/verification_memo.md, 2026-06-12), a red-team check of key numbers against outside sources. | A1 |
| VM-002 | A document that program_manifest.md cites next to VM-001 (by its name, a second verification memo) but that exists only on claude.ai, not in the repository. | A1; also A11 |
| Voltage (V) | The energy given to each coulomb of charge, measured in volts (joules per coulomb). | A5 |
| Volume | How much is bought, measured here in tonnes per year (t/yr). | A10 |
| Wald interval | The simple interval p-hat +/- z\*sqrt(p-hat(1-p-hat)/N), which can spill outside 0 to 1 near the extremes. | A8; also B11 |
| Watt (W) | The SI unit of power, J/s. | A1; also A5 |
| Wave speed | The speed sqrt(E/rho) at which stretch disturbances travel along the cable (about 14.4 km/s here). | A7 |
| Weakest input | The least-supported input in the model; here fiber_cost_per_kg, which is null. | A11 |
| Weakest-link rule | The envelope's top-level confidence is the lowest confidence among its provenance sources, not among its leaves. | B1; also B10, C1 |
| Web Worker | A background browser thread with no access to the page, which talks to it only by messages; Aster runs propagation and porkchop solves in workers. | B4; also B7, B9 |
| WebGL | The browser's interface to the GPU for 3D drawing. | A12; also B9 |
| Weibull statistics | A weakest-link probability model engineers use for strength scatter and the size effect (from memory, verify). | A6 |
| Weight | The gravitational force on a mass, W = m g, measured in newtons. | A2; also A3 |
| Willingness to pay | The most a customer will pay for a service, capped by the substitute's price. | A10 |
| Wilson interval (Wilson score interval) | A confidence interval for a proportion that stays sensible at small n and near 0 or 1, but still assumes independent trials. | A8; also B11 |
| Window (opportunity) | A connected island of grid cells whose converged C3 is at or below a threshold T. | B6 |
| Window (virtualised list) | The set of real rows placed at their true positions near the visible area. | B9 |
| Wire bytes | The compressed bytes actually sent over the network, which set download time. | B9 |
| Withdrawal | A throw of an upbound payload, which lowers the tether's orbit. | A5 |
| Work | Force times the distance moved along the force, W = F\*d\*cos(theta). | A5 |
| Work-energy theorem | The net work done on a body equals its change in kinetic energy. | A5 |
| Workbook | The project's Excel financial model, tools/financial/skyhook_financial_model.xlsx. | A4; also A5, A12 |
| Workflow | A CI recipe file listing triggers, jobs and steps. | A12 |
| Working capital | Cash tied up in day-to-day operations; not modelled. | A9 |
| Working characteristic velocity (V_w) | V_c computed with the working stress instead of datasheet strength, V_c·√((1 − d)/SF); 1.443 km/s at the conservative rung. | A6 |
| Working stress (σ\_w) | The stress each cross-section is designed to carry in steady operation, σ(1 − d)/SF; 1.624 GPa at the Rev A conservative rung. | A6 |
| Worktree (working copy, checkout) | The set of a repository's files written onto one computer's disk; it is dirty when it holds uncommitted changes, and git can attach several to one repository. | A11; also A12, B10, B12 |
| x (working ratio) | The ratio v_tip/V_w = (v_tip/V_c)·√(SF/(1 − d)) that drives EQ-5 and EQ-6; 1.7326 at the Rev A conservative case. | A6 |
| XML | A text format that wraps data in named tags; an .xlsx file is a ZIP of XML parts. | A11 |
| Y15 (model year) | Year 15 of the Skyhook finance model, the horizon by which the case must pay back; Yn means model year n. | A1; also A8, A9, A10 |
| YAML | A text format where indentation shows nesting, used for ci.yml. | A12; also B12 |
| Yarkovsky effect | A tiny thrust on a small asteroid from uneven re-radiation of absorbed sunlight as heat (from memory, verify). | B3 |
| YES2 | A 2007 flight that deployed 31.7 km of tether and delivered a capsule by tether swing. | A5 |
| Young's modulus (E, elastic modulus) | Stress divided by strain in the elastic range, a material property measuring how hard it is to stretch (270 GPa for PBO per MP-001). | A6 |
| z | The number of standard errors that covers the middle 95% of a normal distribution, 1.96. | B11 |
| Zenodo | A public research archive that issues DOIs (CERN-operated, from memory, verify). | B11 |
| ZIP | A compressed bundle of several files in one file. | A11; also A12 |
| zod | A TypeScript library for writing schemas as code; the MCP SDK converts zod schemas to JSON Schema and checks arguments with zod at run time. | B10 |
| ZodEffects / E3-a | The zod wrapper type created by .superRefine, which made the SDK publish porkchop_scan with empty properties until commit 41abd8a moved the checks into handler code. | B10 |
| Zylon (PBO) | A commercially available high-strength polymer fibre; Rev A's primary_fiber and the basis of all stored mass ratios. | A1; also A6, A10 |
| Δ (delta) | Greek letter meaning 'change in'; Δv is a change in speed. | A4 |
| Δv budget | A list of every speed change a mission must pay for, including losses and credits. | A4; also B7 |
| Δv substituted / Δv saved | The speed change a vehicle no longer has to make because the tether tip meets it below orbital speed. | A4 |
| λ (Lambert lambda) | A dimensionless number in [−1, 1], ±sqrt(1 − c/s), that encodes the transfer triangle's shape; its sign marks short versus long way. | B5 |
